title: What Is Thyroid Surgery?
description: What thyroid surgery (thyroidectomy) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Thyroid surgery (thyroidectomy) removes part or all of the gland because of nodules, goiter or cancer. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Thyroid surgery (thyroidectomy) removes part or all of the gland because of nodules, goiter or cancer.

How is it done?

It is performed through an incision in the neck; there are techniques that protect aesthetics and the nerves of the voice.

When is it indicated?

Suspicious nodules, a goiter that compresses nearby structures, hyperthyroidism that is not controlled, or cancer. The specialist decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.q: Is thyroid surgery an outpatient procedure?
faqs.a: It depends on the procedure and the clinic; the specialist will tell you after the evaluation.

faqs.q: Who decides whether I need it?
faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.

title: Risks and Complications of Thyroid Surgery
description: Risks and possible complications of thyroid surgery and how they are reduced through evaluation and follow-up.
tldr: Like any surgery, thyroid surgery has risks: injury to the voice nerve, effects on the parathyroid glands (calcium) and bleeding. They are uncommon and are reduced with proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them during the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of thyroid surgery is part of a responsible decision.

Possible complications

Injury to the voice nerve, effects on the parathyroid glands (calcium) and bleeding.

How they are reduced

A complete pre-operative evaluation, careful technique and close follow-up. The experience of the team influences the results.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.

faqs.q: What warning signs should I watch for?
faqs.a: Difficulty breathing, voice changes, tingling or cramps (low calcium) or bleeding.
